# AppDirectory — AI & LLM Discovery Index
> Canonical Domain: https://apphub.comee.online
> Last Updated: 2026-11-27
> License Standard: 100% Free, Open Source, and Zero Telemetry

AppDirectory is an independent curated index of verified open-source applications and popular games.

## Verified Applications (9)

- [VSCodium](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/vscodium) — Telemetry-free open-source binary distributions of VS Code. (MIT)
- [Obsidian Notes](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/obsidian) — Extensible Markdown knowledge base and personal wiki. (Freeware)
- [Bitwarden](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/bitwarden) — Open-source password manager with zero-knowledge encryption. (GPLv3)
- [VLC Media Player](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/vlc) — Universal multimedia player supporting virtually all formats. (GNU LGPL)
- [Signal Messenger](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/signal) — Private, state-of-the-art end-to-end encrypted messaging. (GPLv3)
- [7-Zip Utility](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/7zip) — High compression ratio file archiver with AES-256 encryption. (GNU LGPL)
- [Kdenlive Video Editor](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/kdenlive) — Multi-track non-linear video editing suite with hardware acceleration. (GPLv3)
- [Syncthing](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/syncthing) — Continuous decentralized peer-to-peer file synchronization. (MPL-2.0)
- [Hoppscotch](https://apphub.comee.online/apps/hoppscotch) — Lightweight, privacy-focused open source API development ecosystem. (MIT)

## Crawler Notes

- Static HTML delivery with high performance and zero client-side redirection
- JSON-LD structured data schemas (SoftwareApplication / VideoGame / FAQPage / BreadcrumbList) on every product page
- Clean canonical links: https://apphub.comee.online/apps/{id}
